N8N Chat UI is a no-code builder for branded AI chat widgets, built for n8n users, agencies, SaaS teams, and businesses. Design a mobile-friendly chat experience with live preview, then connect it to any n8n workflow and embed it anywhere. Unlike default n8n chat, it adds deep customization, streaming, voice and file uploads, flexible layouts, and a JavaScript API for advanced integrations.

If you’re wiring Chat Trigger / AI Agent / memory / tools inside n8n, it can help scaffold and fix that graph faster, but the quality of the chat experience still comes from your prompt, tools, and flow design.
